limits: Reads the editor's state; with nothing open there is no record.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Hands on the open record unchanged; it computes nothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which record is open in the editor?

description: Return the plasmid/sequence currently open in the editor. Emits it as a `record`, so it is the SOURCE node of a pipeline — wire its record into any downstream node's $subject.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

name: get_open_record

record.description: the open sequence record (subject for downstream nodes)
